proposed_machine.billing_notice: The new instance may remain billable until deletion is confirmed by the provider. Test process expiry does not delete the VM.

source_references.r4_adapter_manifest_and_bundle: not prepared or frozen; requires this round confirmation and fresh pinning

credential_boundary.transport: Reuse only AST-extracted strict SSH/COMMON literals from the existing panel credential bridge; never import or execute an old campaign.
credential_boundary.database_access: Read-only transaction limited to the selected Linode credential context and safety-flag/code-fingerprint observations.
credential_boundary.provider_token: Used only inside the existing credential bridge; never printed, saved locally or sent to the test VM.
credential_boundary.operator_login: Existing operator Ed25519 public key only, no password or keyboard-interactive login.
credential_boundary.host_identity: Fresh run-bound preseeded SSH host key and known_hosts with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, IdentitiesOnly=yes, BatchMode=yes and UpdateHostKeys=no; no TOFU or bypass.

production_gate_policy.any_drift: Stop; do not change, cache, infer or enable production settings to pass admission.

mandatory_before_create: Obtain explicit approval of this new R4 scope and cleanup plan; earlier R3 and R2 approvals are not reused.
Verify the repair record, public helper and candidate hashes and all closed R3/R2 evidence without editing them; any source change invalidates the preparation until reviewed and freshly recorded.

Prepare a fresh R4 adapter, paths, ownership markers, unit names, host identity and transport pins from public source only; copy no old authority, intent, receipt, credential, known_hosts or campaign entry point.

Delegate both the public harness safe_runtime and collector to the same pinned canonical strict runtime projector. Pin the repaired iputils projector and collector together, including real control pre-admission.

Run offline regression through actual component collection, exclusive JSON persistence, reread, collector projection, control readmission and cleanup aggregation. Valid proofs must survive unchanged and malformed/missing proofs must remain failures; no already-projected success bypass.

Regress first-error null, malformed metadata, truncated/dropped error history, case cardinality and per-case packet budgets, nonzero exit, checkpoint recovery, timeout/SIGTERM and cleanup before freezing the new LF-only archive.
Freeze all executed R4 inputs, safe archive members, source and binary SHA256, cloud-init size and sanitized collector. No dispatched or closed bundle may be patched in place.

After approval only, perform fresh read-only credential/account, permission, region/type/image, backup/firewall-default, complete-inventory and direct operator IPv4 preflight. Read-only success is not proof of provider capacity or actual create/delete permission.

Verify all production safety switches off, with only the explicitly approved exact legacy fingerprint compatibility. Unknown state stops; do not alter existing cloud defaults, firewalls or production settings.
Create a durable exclusive run-bound intent before the sole create POST. An unknown response permits bounded GET reconciliation only; no second create or different account fallback.

isolation.ssh_source: Only the freshly verified direct operator public IPv4.
isolation.allowed_setup: Debian runtime/test prerequisites only, no panel, web stack, queue, Redis, MySQL or persistent node daemon.
isolation.network: Fresh private PID/network/mount namespaces, loopback only, no external route.
isolation.test_identity: Non-root, no supplementary groups, zero capabilities, no_new_privs.
isolation.public_helpers: Root-owned known-path 0644 files, no symlinks or group/other writes.
isolation.private_materials: 0600 files or 0700 directories; synthetic credentials only, TLS verification retained.

validation_order: Fresh guest ownership, host identity, key-only SSH and default-drop ingress; no other public TCP listener.
Real 0711/non-root bootstrap and structured-error smoke with owned negative fixtures; no private credential reads.
Strict projector import/persistence smoke in the same staged package, followed by all six real iputils kernel cases.
Exact binary identities, verified local TLS, HY2 TCP byte echo and two UDP datagrams; no protocol retry.
Saved supervisor report -> collector -> saved/reloaded aggregate -> control pre-admission. All raw typed packet, isolation and cleanup proofs must survive and be revalidated at each boundary.

Five serial real controls: communicate timeout, externally delivered SIGTERM, GNU timeout, socket negatives and filesystem/report recovery. Expected negative exit/status is required, not called application success.
CPU/RSS/OOM/resource summaries, durable sanitized first-error and final/partial evidence, then cleanup and independent provider absence checks.

acceptance_rules.skips_or_missing_required_proofs: Failure, never zero loss or inferred success.
acceptance_rules.reprojection: Recompute from typed proofs at every boundary; require stable sanitized evidence through persistence and recollection.
acceptance_rules.first_error: Retain earliest allowlisted diagnostic and durable checkpoint before teardown; later failures cannot replace it.
acceptance_rules.socket_scope: Keep the fixed-loopback listener and exact live PID/start-time/inode rules. No relaxation of wildcard, public peer or unknown-owner checks.
acceptance_rules.oom_or_protection_trigger: Fail and clean this owned test.
acceptance_rules.data_export: Bounded allowlisted aggregate evidence only; no raw logs, config bodies, traceback text, credentials or user data.
acceptance_rules.dependent_stages_after_failure: Not executed. No in-place patch, replay, replacement VM or silent retry.

cleanup.scope: This new R4 VM, exact owned transient units/PID-start identities, private fixtures and temporary materials only.
cleanup.before_removing_guest_work: Persist and independently reread bounded sanitized first-error/final/partial evidence locally; do not reconstruct absent evidence.
cleanup.guest_cleanup: Verify exact run owner and paths, stop and reap only owned tests and remove private fixtures; never weaken SSH host verification.
cleanup.provider_delete: Recheck bound credential context, receipt ID, exact label/tag, region/type/image and creation identity before deleting this single owned VM.
cleanup.delete_retry: Each attempt needs a separate durable claim and fresh GET proving the same owned identity. Never replay a claimed attempt; unknown GET or context drift permits no mutation.
cleanup.absence_proof: Two independent GET-404 plus complete-inventory absence observations at least 8 seconds apart.
cleanup.ssh_unavailable: Mark guest evidence unavailable and still attempt deletion of the provider-verified own VM, without relaxing SSH validation.
cleanup.unconfirmed_deletion: Notify safe resource identity and uncertainty/possible ongoing billing; never claim cleanup or create another VM.
cleanup.controller_loss: Guest limits stop test processes but do not delete a billable VM; recover ownership-bound cleanup and confirm absence.

excluded: No live credential bridge, SSH, cloud/DNS API, dispatch or execution authority before this R4 confirmation.
No GitHub, release, image publication, production deployment, business-node upgrade/restart, queue/default change or database/configuration write.
No automatic boot/create, credential rotation, DNS switching, recurring scheduler or automation; all persistent automatic switches stay off.
No public ICMP to mainland targets, censorship determination, WAN fault injection, candidate replacement, DNS/TTL or complete failover acceptance.
No tanzhen access, reuse of old-round authorization, imports of old campaign entry points or changes to closed evidence.
